summary: Inventory and vars plugins should apply trust_as_template only to values that legitimately contain templates, never to external values that could be maliciously altered. API still incomplete.
questions: Should my inventory plugin mark host variables as trusted templates?
How do I allow templates in variables from a custom inventory plugin?
Is it safe to trust variables from an external CMDB?

answer_card.title: Template trust in inventory and vars plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
Inventory plugins set host and group variables, which are usually static external values that don't need trust. Values that should contain templates need explicit `trust_as_template` to render. **Do not** apply trust to values from external sources that could be maliciously altered to include templates.

This API is currently incomplete.
